risks.risk: The irons may have electrical faults or damaged cords that could pose a safety hazard.
risks.proof: Close-up of the cord insulation and plug, showing no fraying, burns, or exposed wires.

risks.risk: The irons may be counterfeit or non-genuine Panasonic or Good brand products.
risks.proof: A clear shot of the brand logo and model number on the iron, ideally with a serial number or barcode.

Close-up of the cord and plug to check for damage.
Clear photo of the brand and model number on the iron, preferably with a serial number or barcode.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
